answer: Operator-Linked Cluster Disclosure: each new identity must declare a shared operator key with its existing identities. If one identity in a cluster is proven fake, all sibling identities are frozen and the operator’s standing in every registry is cut, hitting reputation and revenue even on honest wallets. Dormant clusters surface on a tundra of cold keys, so the cost is losing the whole portfolio, not one knoll of it. An attacker watching a comet of short-lived identities must rebuild each operator cluster from zero.
